description: 한국전자통신연구원_한국어 언어분석 통합 말뭉치 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 엑소브레인 과제를 수행하면서 구축한 언어처리 학습데이터로 언어분석 6개 기술(형태소분석, 다의어 어휘의미분석, 세분류 개체명인식, 의존구문분석, 의미역인식, 상호참조해결)의 태깅 가이드라인과 자연어 질의응답을 위한 질문/정답 포맷의 뉴스기사 대상 태깅 말뭉치이 포함되어 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 언어분석, 엑소브레인, 인공지능, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2021-11-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
